title: Data Dictionary
text: Three producers stand behind datasets. Producer granularity dataset METRO SP transparency portal. Companhia Metropolitano de São Paulo publishes monthly demand reports transparency portal, covering Lines 1, 2, 3, 15, Line 5 July 2018. Values reported thousands. Insper Dataverse. Line 4 (ViaQuatro) Line 5 August 2018 (ViaMobilidade) come Insper Dataverse, starting January 2012 August 2018 respectively. Counts rounded nearest thousand, pipeline multiplies METRO values 1,000 combining two. GeoSampa. Line station geometries come GeoSampa, City São Paulo’s open geospatial platform. currently operating planned infrastructure included. Station identity. station_id identifies physical station complex, station_name retains official name used station member. Complex membership maintained committed crosswalk official network sources; inferred name similarity distance. Thus Consolação Paulista retain different names share one station_id. term producer deliberate. Combining sources takes substantial cleaning, pipeline lives package’s GitHub repository.
